title: Chat requests
summary: The box of chat requests: DM invites from people who want to start a conversation. A row at the top of the Conversas tab opens it; each request opens chat-request. Requests never show in the chat list until accepted.

roomId.description: The invited room. Stable key for the row.

inviterId.description: Matrix ID of the person who invited.

avatarUrl.description: The inviter's avatar. Missing when hidePhotos is on.

trust.description: verified: the account has a verified name. unverified: no verified name. external: an account on another Matrix server.

rowCount.description: The number on the requests row of the chat list. 0 hides the row.

openBox.effect: From the requests row: opens this screen.

notes: A request is a room with membership invited and RoomInfo.isDm true (filter Invite plus Category People). Group invites are not requests: they show as invite rows in the Grupos tab (chat-list-filters).
The server already applies who can message me (ADR 0038): an invite that the setting refuses never arrives. The box holds what passed.

Requests stay out of chat-list and out of the Conversas unread badge (ADR 0053: Pedidos is a row, not a tab). The row shows rowCount when it is above 0, with bipe_requests_title and bipe_requests_row_body.

Trust per row: verified shows the verified seal (bipe_badge_verified), unverified shows bipe_banner_unverified_title, external shows bipe_banner_external. Move, do not rewrite: BipeKit BipeTrustProfile.swift and BadgeVerifier.swift, libraries/bipe BipeTrustProfile.kt and BadgeVerifier.kt (GET /v1/badges/{userId}).
hidePhotos: rows show the initials avatar, never the photo, until accepted.
Empty box: bipe_app_requests_empty and a link row bipe_messaging_title to the setting.
A request from a blocked person never shows (Matrix ignore list).
